title: Eight learned streamflow models underestimated peak days in a basin audit
summary: A 162-basin evaluation found median peak-day biases of 27% to 44% below observed flow across eight learned models, versus 13% below for the National Water Model. The learned models also underestimated peak days in a broader analysis of 1,139 basins.
ai_technology: LSTM, GRU, EA-LSTM and five other learned streamflow models
organization: Rutgers University; Apple; University of Alabama; University of Maryland

evidence.tested: Models trained through water year 2010 were scored against recorded streamflow over 2011–2022. Bias was summarized over basins.
evidence.unknown: Model tuning and inputs were constrained. The external National Water Model used its developers’ calibration, which may overlap the test period. Flow estimates at extremes carry observational uncertainty.
evidence.ai_role: Eight models learned mappings from weather history and basin attributes to daily streamflow; their held-out errors revealed the common peak-day deficit.
